Job Role : Junior Python Developer

inTechNative is seeking motivated Python Developer for our client

Experience : Fresher

Location : Remote

About the Role:

We are seeking a passionate Junior Python Developer to join our dynamic engineering team at ALTOS Technologies.

This role offers the unique opportunity to contribute to high-impact web and machine learning projects while working alongside industry experts.

We provide a structured mentorship environment designed to accelerate your growth as a software engineer.

Key Responsibilities
Develop clean, maintainable, and efficient server-side logic using Python.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate user-facing elements with server-side logic.
Debug and troubleshoot existing applications to ensure optimal performance and reliability.
Participate in code reviews to maintain high quality standards and share technical knowledge.
Document technical specifications and workflows to support ongoing project maintenance.
Assist in the deployment and scaling of web applications across various cloud environments.
Required Qualifications
Required: A strong grasp of core Python programming and object-oriented design principles.
Required: A degree in Computer Science or a related technical field with a portfolio of projects.
Knowledge of web frameworks such as Django or Flask for building scalable backends.
Understanding of database management using SQL or NoSQL technologies.
Familiarity with version control systems, specifically Git, to manage collaborative codebases.



Disclaimer: This job posting and Location has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.
